title: Current work
description: We're currently working on our 2026 Australian Rover Challenge Entry, with a focus on the software and science subsystem. We're growing our team, so come get involved!
The ROAR Team continued to score higher at ARCh, as well as receiving an invitation to demonstrate at NASA's Lunabotics challenge!
The ROAR Team achieved a fantastic 4th place, with the brand new Perseus, and with the help of our mini-rover Talaria!
The ROAR Team's first year saw Artemis compete, winning 4th place!
